# ghost_organization_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of an organization and, for its admins, its outside collaborators. Members of the organization see every member; anyone else sees only the members who made their membership public. Ghost doesn't return members' roles (`viewer_role` is the token user's own), and the list isn't paginated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ghost_organization_members" "all" {
  organization = "my-org"
}

# Admins can also list the people outside the organization who have, or are
# invited to, a role on its repositories.
data "ghost_organization_members" "with_outside_collaborators" {
  organization                  = "my-org"
  include_outside_collaborators = true
}

output "members" {
  value = data.ghost_organization_members.all.usernames
}

output "public_members" {
  value = [for m in data.ghost_organization_members.all.members : m.username if m.public]
}

output "outside_collaborators" {
  value = {
    for c in data.ghost_organization_members.with_outside_collaborators.outside_collaborators :
    c.username => { for r in c.repositories : r.full_name => r.pending ? "${r.role} (pending)" : r.role }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The slug of the organization. Ghost matches it case-insensitively. The token's user doesn't need to be a member, unless `include_outside_collaborators` is set.

### Optional

- `include_outside_collaborators` (Boolean) Also list the organization's outside collaborators into `outside_collaborators`. Only admins of the organization can list them, so reading fails for anyone else. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization's slug as Ghost spells it (lower case).
- `members` (Attributes List) The organization's members, sorted by username. Members of the organization see every member; anyone else sees only the members who made their membership public. Roles aren't included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `outside_collaborators` (Attributes List) With `include_outside_collaborators`, the people who aren't members but have, or are invited to, a role on the organization's repositories, sorted by username. Members invited to a repository aren't listed. Null unless `include_outside_collaborators` is `true`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outside_collaborators))
- `usernames` (List of String) The usernames of `members`, in the same order.
- `viewer_role` (String) The token user's role in the organization: `member`, `admin` or `owner`. Null when the user isn't a member (so `members` lists only public members), or holds only custom roles.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `image` (String) The member's avatar URL, null when they have none.
- `name` (String) The member's display name.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the member shows their membership outside the organization.
- `username` (String) The member's username.


<a id="nestedatt--outside_collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outside_collaborators`

Read-Only:

- `image` (String) The collaborator's avatar URL, null when they have none.
- `name` (String) The collaborator's display name.
- `repositories` (Attributes List) The organization's repositories the collaborator has, or is invited to, a role on, sorted by slug. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outside_collaborators--repositories))
- `username` (String) The collaborator's username.

<a id="nestedatt--outside_collaborators--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outside_collaborators.repositories`

Read-Only:

- `full_name` (String) The repository's full name, `organization/slug`. Pass it to the `repository` argument of other resources.
- `pending` (Boolean) Whether the user was invited and hasn't accepted yet.
- `role` (String) The collaborator's role on the repository: `read`, `triage`, `write`, `maintain` or `admin`.
- `slug` (String) The repository's slug.
